asr.full_text: Music My name is Yang, and I am an associate at investment banking at JPMorgan, So I sit within the investment banking business, and I work in the financial institutions group. I guess, in very simple layman's terms, we give financial advice to our clients. The question is, what kind of financial advice? What we try to do is to help them make investment decisions and then we also help them raise capital, equity, debts or other more exotic or complicated securities. We got a few cornerstone investment opportunities that you can go into. About five years ago, I realized in Investment Banking something that I really wanted to do. One, I'm a very analytical person and two, I'm really a good people's person. These are the two the truest quality that you will need for investment banking. As an associate, there are two parts to my job. We really support the senior bankers in making a different analysis. That's one part and then we also directly answer to our clients. So that's the second part of our job, we work with our clients directly and basically help them with questions they have. It's actually a great feeling to know that we're helping the client solve these problems. The deals are, as you would expect, vastly complicated, so feeling that sense of accomplishment is certainly very rewarding. Your contribution is widely recognized. Work-life balance is an integral part of the JPMorgan culture our seniors really care about thwart-life balance of our juniors because without enough balance most people get burned out pretty quickly it's hard to be working hard if you're not getting enough rest on the weekend why hike a caregiver charged and I refreshed my mind I also really enjoy cooking it's somewhat similar to investment banking. You have to decide on what you want to make and then come up with ways that you actually take out the steps. So, that's not very dissimilar except that there's no pressure. If I make a mistake or if I make a bad dish that's all right. I'll just eat it anyway. One of the key cultural aspect of JP Morgan is the team work. Let's try to keep touch with our client base see where the market goes by then. Collaboration is absolutely critical and we really depend on each other for the success of the team. If you actually walk around the JP Morgan campus whether it's in Hong Kong, New York or London, you get the same feeling it's almost as if you're working the same office and It's almost as if you're working in the same office. And that's something very special. You won't feel any cultural barrier between these offices. It's just a tremendously dynamic profession that I'm engaged in. It's certainly very rewarding. JPMorgan Chase has a culture, and it's a work-hard culture. It's a respect-each-other culture. It's a support-our-client. It's a do-the-right-thing. It's everything that you hear J.B. Diamond say

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is non-scam content because it presents an employee profile about investment banking work, teamwork, and work-life balance, while directing viewers to apply to J.P. Morgan rather than make an investment or payment. The interview-style presentation and “Leadership Stories” and “Our People” end card support a recruitment and corporate-culture context, and the described material does not show a viewer-facing investment return promise, required payment, credential request, or deceptive financial solicitation.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The primary context is an ordinary corporate employment and financial-services profile: the speaker describes his investment-banking role and client services, while the description provides an application direction.
